items.title: 19.2 DNA as the hereditary material (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the search for the hereditary material (PDF 119).

blocks.text: Jab yeh baatein pakki ho gayin ke:

items: genes chromosomes par hote hain, aur
chromosomes DNA aur proteins se bane hain,

blocks.text: to scientists ne yeh maloom karne ki koshish ki ke genes DNA se bane hain, protein se, ya dono se. Is sawal ka jawab dhoondne mein taqreeban 30 saal (1920s se 1950s tak) lage.

blocks.title: Information

blocks.prompt: Genetic material ki koi do khoobiyan batayein.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi do: proteins ke amino acids ki tarteeb ka code dena; cell division se pehle replication; eukaryotic cell ke nucleus mein hona; waqt ke saath badal sakna (evolution ke liye).

items: Sawal (1920s-1950s): genes DNA se bane hain, protein se ya dono se?
Genetic material code de, replicate ho, nucleus mein ho aur badal sake: yeh sab sirf DNA karta hai.
